_comment: Manifest for the self-hosted Alaska lidar DEM collection.
target_epsg: the *appropriate local UTM zone*, NAD83(2011) realization.
MatSu is delivered tagged UTM 5N but spans 150.5W - 147.0W, i.e. almost
entirely zone 6 and up to 3 degrees past the zone 5 edge. It is the one
dataset that gets a genuine zone change.
Source datum tags are honored literally (user decision, 2026-09-05):
Lower_KP and MatSu declare WGS 84, so a real WGS84 -> NAD83(2011) datum
transform is applied to them. Homer (NAD83) and KBay (NAD83(2011)) stay
in the NAD83 family. If the WGS84 tags turn out to be a vendor mislabel,
those two will sit ~1-2 m off Homer/KBay and must be rebuilt with an
max_zoom: chosen so one web-mercator pixel ~= one source pixel at that

datasets.title: Homer 2019 bare-earth DTM
datasets.notes: Source NAD83 / UTM 5N (EPSG:26905), LZW, 128x128 blocks. No vertical CRS declared.

datasets.title: Lower Kenai Peninsula lidar DEM
datasets.notes: Source tagged WGS 84 / UTM 5N (EPSG:32605). Uncompressed and stripe-blocked (43603x1) - must be converted to a tiled COG before any windowed read. No vertical CRS declared.

datasets.title: Kachemak Bay 2023 lidar DEM
datasets.notes: Arrives as a valid COG (ZSTD, 512 blocks) in a COMPOUND CRS: NAD83(2011) / UTM 5N + NAVD88 height. Already the target horizontal zone, so the archive stage copies rather than warps - warping to a 2D EPSG:6334 would be an identity resample that also silently drops the declared NAVD88 vertical datum. It is the only one of the four that declares its vertical reference. Web tiles rebuilt 2026-09-06: the compound NAVD88 CRS made gdalwarp geoid-shift full-res reads but not overview reads (see CLAUDE.md); the archive now has GDAL-computed overviews (translate mode).

datasets.title: Mat-Su Valley 2019 bare-earth DEM
datasets.notes: 82 GB SAGA .sdat, stripe-blocked. No vertical CRS declared. ELEVATIONS ARE IN FEET and are converted to metres on ingest (vertical_scale): the raw grid reads 246.1 at Palmer and 341.5 at Wasilla, whose published elevations are 240 ft and 344 ft - a metres reading would put downtown Palmer at 807 ft. Homer and Lower Kenai agree with each other in metres at an overlap point (19.84 vs 20.06), so the foot units are MatSu's alone. International foot assumed; the US survey foot differs by 2 ppm (3 mm at 1500 m), which is far below the data's own accuracy. Zone-5-tagged but lies in zone 6 - this is the one real reprojection. max_zoom 16 (1.14 m) rather than 17 (0.57 m): 17 would oversample 0.91 m source 1.6x for 4x the bytes.

datasets.title: Matanuska Valley 2011 bare-earth DTM (9 ft)
datasets.notes: Mat-Su Borough 2011 lidar (flown 2011-05-10..12), Matanuska River corridor from Palmer east to ~147.2W. Source is NAD83 / Alaska State Plane zone 4 in US survey feet (FIPS 5004), 9 ft posts, uncompressed, 128x128 blocks. ELEVATIONS ARE IN FEET (metadata: altunits feet, NAVD88 via GEOID09) and are converted to metres on ingest; max 5873 in the raw grid is 1790 m, which is right for the Chugach/Talkeetna summits here and impossible in metres. Verified against matsu_2019 at Palmer airport, Sutton and Chickaloon: 70.78/137.04/414.87 m vs 70.94/137.17/415.10 m. Lies in UTM zone 6. max_zoom 15 (2.27 m) for 2.74 m source.

datasets.title: Seward 2023 bare-earth DTM
datasets.notes: Arrives as a valid COG (LZW, 512 blocks, overviews) in a COMPOUND CRS: NAD83(2011) / UTM 6N + NAVD88 height (GEOID12B), unit metre. Already the target zone, so the archive stage copies (same reasoning as kbay_2023). 75000x84000 grid, 38.8% valid: Resurrection Bay from Seward north up the Resurrection River valley. Source directory also holds _shade and _mod5 derivatives, which the viewer renders client-side instead. Web tiles rebuilt 2026-09-06: the compound NAVD88 CRS made gdalwarp geoid-shift full-res reads but not overview reads (see CLAUDE.md); the archive now has GDAL-computed overviews (translate mode).

datasets.title: Glen Alps 2024 bare-earth DTM
datasets.notes: Municipality of Anchorage lidar, flown 2024-03-25..08-17 (DGGS RDF 2025-19). Compound CRS NAD83(2011)/UTM 6N + NAVD88 (GEOID12B), metres, 1 m posts, LZW with 128x128 blocks and external overviews -- not a COG, so the archive stage translates in place, keeping the vertical CRS. Chugach front range above Anchorage. max_zoom 16 (1.15 m) for 1 m source. Web tiles rebuilt 2026-09-06 after the compound-CRS geoid-shift band bug (see CLAUDE.md).

datasets.title: South Fork Eagle River 2024 bare-earth DTM
datasets.notes: Municipality of Anchorage lidar, flown 2024-03-24..08-17 (DGGS RDF 2025-20). Compound CRS NAD83(2011)/UTM 6N + NAVD88 (GEOID12B), metres, 1 m posts, LZW, not a COG -- translated in place. max_zoom 16 (1.15 m) for 1 m source. Web tiles rebuilt 2026-09-06 after the compound-CRS geoid-shift band bug (see CLAUDE.md).

datasets.title: Columbia Glacier 2022 DTM (20 cm)
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2023-16, flown 2022-09-18 (metadata caldate 2022-09-22). NAD83(2011)/UTM 6N, NAVD88 (GEOID12B) per metadata though the file carries no vertical CRS; metres; 0.2 m posts, LZW, not a COG -- translated in place. Terminus area of Columbia Glacier, ~35 km2 bbox. A glacier surface, so it dates fast: the ice here has been retreating and thinning since 1980. max_zoom 18 (0.29 m) for 0.2 m source; 19 would be 4x the bytes for 1.4x oversampling.

datasets.title: Sitka 2018-2019 bare-earth DTM
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2026-19, flown 2018-04-27..29 and 2019-09-27..28. Named NAD83(2011)/UTM 8N in the file but the embedded Transverse Mercator has every parameter zeroed (lon origin 0, false easting 0), so GDAL puts the corners at 7 deg E; src_srs re-tags it as EPSG:6337 without touching pixels. World file agrees with the tag to a half pixel. NAVD88 (GEOID12B) per metadata, metres, 0.5 m posts, uncompressed 9.1 GB with external overviews. First zone-8 dataset in the collection. max_zoom 17 (0.65 m) for 0.5 m source at 56.8N.

datasets.title: Goodwin Glacier 2023 bare-earth DTM
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2025-7. Compound CRS NAD83(2011)/UTM 6N + NAVD88 (GEOID12B), metres, 0.5 m posts, uncompressed with external overviews. Goodwin Glacier, east of Cordova. max_zoom 17 (0.59 m).

datasets.title: Ketchikan 2023 bare-earth DTM (0.5 m)
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2024-31, the wider 2023 collection. Compound CRS NAD83(2011)/UTM 9N + NAVD88 (GEOID12B), metres, 0.5 m posts. First zone-9 dataset (EPSG:6338). max_zoom 17 (0.68 m at 55.4N).

datasets.title: Ketchikan 2024 bare-earth DTM (20 cm)
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2024-31, the 2024 20 cm re-flight over the town core (~6 km2 inside the 2023 footprint). Compound CRS NAD83(2011)/UTM 9N + NAVD88 (GEOID12B), metres. max_zoom 18 (0.34 m).

datasets.title: Dickason Highlands 2024 bare-earth DTM
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2025-12 (folder spelled 'Dickson', metadata 'Dickason Highlands'). Compound CRS NAD83(2011)/UTM 5N + NAVD88 (GEOID12B), metres, 1 m posts. West side of Cook Inlet / Beluga uplands. max_zoom 16 (1.13 m).

datasets.title: Grewingk Glacier 2021 bare-earth DTM
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2023-2, flown 2021-10-12: Grewingk Glacier 1967 landslide scar and Halibut Cove Lagoon. Original DGGS 1 m DTM, whose embedded CRS is named NAD83(2011)/UTM 5N with every Transverse Mercator parameter zeroed (corners print at 10 deg E, same defect as Sitka) -- src_srs re-tags it as EPSG:6334 without touching pixels. NAVD88 (GEOID12B) per metadata, no vertical CRS in the file. The same folder holds Grewingk2021_v4_WGS84_UTM5.tif, a copy on the identical grid with pixel-identical values (checked over 9 Mpx), tagged WGS 84 / UTM 5N instead and stripe-blocked; not needed once the original is re-tagged. Uncompressed with external overviews. max_zoom 16 (1.21 m).

datasets.title: Portage 2020 bare-earth DTM (20 cm)
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2024-7, flown October 2020: Portage Lake / Passage Canal hazards inventory. NAD83(2011)/UTM 6N (2-D tag), NAVD88 (GEOID12B) per metadata, metres, 0.2 m posts, uncompressed with external overviews. max_zoom 18 (0.29 m).

datasets.title: Maynard Mountain 2022 bare-earth DTM (20 cm)
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2024-11, flown July 2022: Maynard Mountain above Whittier (rockfall-tsunami study). NAD83(2011)/UTM 6N (2-D tag), NAVD88 (GEOID12B) per metadata, metres, 0.2 m posts, uncompressed with external overviews. Adjoins portage_2020. max_zoom 18 (0.29 m).

datasets.title: Barry Arm 2023-09-19 bare-earth DTM (20 cm)
datasets.notes: DGGS RDF 2025-8, flown 2023-09-19: the Barry Arm landslide. Compound CRS NAD83(2011)/UTM 6N + NAVD88 (GEOID12B), metres, 0.2 m posts, 7.3 GB uncompressed with external overviews. The folder also holds *_dtm_old.tif on the same grid (superseded: the corrected file masks out ~28% of the old footprint and sits 0.57 m lower in median, differing by >1 m on 16% of pixels); the corrected file is used. max_zoom 18 (0.29 m).

datasets.title: Glacier Bay 2019 bare-earth DEM (USGS 3DEP)
datasets.notes: USGS 3DEP OPR AK_GlacierBay_2019_B19 bare-earth tiles: 575 x 1 km LZW GeoTIFFs (2000x2000 px, 0.5 m, Float32, nodata -999999) in /Volumes/Powder/Alaska GIS/Raster/AK_lidar/Glacier_Bay_2019/, all NAD83(2011)/UTM 8N, no overlaps. Built from the ORIGINAL tiles through a gdalbuildvrt mosaic (tools: vrt/glacier_bay_2019.vrt, tile list alongside) rather than the earlier hand-merged Reprocessed/Merged.tif. ~526 km2 of data in strips (Alsek, Lituya, Crillon; QL1 and QL2 blocks) inside a 120 x 43 km box, so most of the grid is nodata. No metadata file in the folder: NAVD88 is the 3DEP standard for this project and is assumed. max_zoom 17 (0.62 m at 58.6N).
